The '''''Jendirian Valley''''' was an [[AA-9 Coruscant freighter/Legends|AA-9 Coruscant freighter]] which was famous for helping refugees. Its middle deck had been modified to hold 30,000 beings. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] journeyed aboard the ''Valley'', disguised as refugees, to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] after the attempt on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Amidala's life.

[[File:Refugefamily.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A refugee family in the ''Jendirian Valley'']]
